newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian pilot lands safely in Siberian wastes.
newsitem.headline: Russian pilot lands safely in Siberian wastes.

text.p: A Russian airline pilot made a successful emergency landing in the Siberian wilderness on Wednesday, saving the lives of 20 passengers and four crew, an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman said.

She said the pilot of Yak-40 three-engine jet had managed to establish radio connection with dispatchers after landing near the village of Shushenskoye. It was not clear what airline the plane belonged to.
The pilot said all passengers and crew were "alive and unhurt", the spokeswoman said. She could not say what had caused the emergency landing.
"It is really difficult to imagine where in the taiga (forest) he was able to find a spot to land," she added.
The head of Russia's national air traffic service, Robert Urtsev, later told Reuters the plane had been located by rescue helicopters and said the rescue of passengers and crew was underway.
